meals.name: Mediterranean Beef & Vegetable Traybake with Roasted Broccoli, Mushrooms & Sweet Potato
meals.image_prompt: overhead photo of a roasting tray with seasoned sliced beef, golden sweet potato chunks, charred broccoli and mushrooms coated in herb olive oil, bright Sunday evening light on a dark oven tray
day_of_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 210°C. Cut sweet potato into 2 cm chunks (130 g Diego / 100 g Diana). Toss with 1 tsp olive oil, smoked paprika, dried oregano, salt. Roast 15 min.
2. Add 80 g broccoli florets + 80 g halved mushrooms (Diego) / 60 g broccoli + 60 g mushrooms (Diana) to tray; drizzle 1 tsp olive oil; toss and roast 10 more min.
3. Slice 170 g (Diego) / 130 g (Diana) lean beef into strips; season with garlic powder, dried thyme, black pepper, Dijon mustard (½ tsp).
4. Push veg to sides of tray; lay beef strips in centre. Roast 8 min until beef is cooked through.
5. Serve directly from tray. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar. Drink 500 ml water.
